title: Influence bound for bounded-width CNF
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on an $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose it is computed by a conjunctive normal form whose clauses each contain at most $w$ literals. Then the total influence of $f$ is at most $2w$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
There exists a CNF of width at most $w$ computing $f$
